create_VivitConfig: create a VivitConfig instance to initialize a ViViT video transformer model configuration
build_VivitConfig_custom: build a VivitConfig with custom hyperparameters like num_frames, tubelet_size, and hidden_size
review_VivitConfig_attributes: review the VivitConfig class attributes including image_size, num_hidden_layers, and attention_heads
summarize_VivitConfig_defaults: summarize the default configuration values for a ViViT model from google/vivit-b-16x2-kinetics400
test_VivitConfig_model_type: test that VivitConfig sets model_type to vivit and inherits from PreTrainedConfig
